definition: Make or manufacture from components or raw materials.
exampleSentence: High-quality olive oil is produced by agricultural cooperatives in Andalusia.

definition: Prepare and issue a book, journal, or piece of music for public sale.
exampleSentence: The environmental study was published in an international scientific journal.

definition: Restore something damaged or broken to a good condition.

definition: Create or design something that has not existed before.

definition: Make arrangements or preparations for an event or activity.
exampleSentence: The annual charity marathon was organized by a passionate group of volunteers.
